lines.text: SARA: Now where did Erik go...?\nHe’s the one who wanted to come here!
Here, let me give you the Kangaskhan, Ponyta,\nand Dratini I caught!
Yay! My big sis is sending her Pokémon to\nmy Nintendo Switch!
I’m meeting my dad here! He’s gonna give me\nthe Pokémon he caught!\c\nI hope he comes back soon!
Pokémon brought from Pokémon GO look like\nthey’re having fun in the GO Park complex.
Someone’s walking around with a bunch of\nPokémon brought over from Pokémon GO!
